highlights: The Holidazzle Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at the Schertz Civic Center ($10 per person, children 2 and under free, sessions at 8, 9:15 and 10:30 am) is SOLD OUT, according to the City of Schertz Holidazzle page (schertz.com/community/special_events/holidazzle.php).

Holidazzle on December 5 also brings the free Kris Kringle Market in the Civic Center Grand Ballroom from 10 am to 3 pm, Mt. Schertz and a snow angel play area, and the lighted Festival of Angels night parade, per the city's Holidazzle page.

Deck the City Hall lights the city tree and the Hal Baldwin Municipal Complex on Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 6 to 7 pm, free, per the Schertz Parks and Recreation Fall 2026 and Winter 2027 Fun Guide.
Schertz Parks and Recreation runs a Holiday Cookies decorating class at the North Center on Wednesday, December 16, 2026, 6 to 8 pm, for $40, per the city's Rec1 registration catalog.
Lowe's of Schertz hosts a free Kids Workshop building a Holiday Trolley Car on Saturday, December 12, 2026, 10 am to 1 pm, per Lowe's own Facebook post.

Murdoch's in Schertz holds a free, in-store Step Inside Santa's Workshop on Sunday, December 6, 1 to 4 pm, with ornament making, a Santa placemat and a photo with Santa, and live reindeer on December 12, 2 to 6 pm, per Murdoch's.
